name: Leg-Resisted Concentration Curl
steps: Sit tall on a sturdy chair or the floor, hinge forward slightly, and brace the back of your working upper arm against your inner thigh.
Slide your working hand underneath the back of your opposite thigh or knee with your palm facing up.
Contract your biceps to curl your leg upward while gently pressing your leg downward to create steady self-resistance.
Lower your leg slowly back to the starting position under full tension, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Adjust how hard you press down with your leg so the curl stays smooth and challenging through the full range.
Keep your working upper arm still rather than rocking backward with your torso.
